ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the top of the figure is a crocodile labeled E; below it are fish, including a fish labeled D in the middle and a fish labeled C at the lower left. The arrows point from the direction of the fish below toward the crocodile. Reasoning: The arrows in the food chain diagram indicate energy or food going from the organism being eaten toward the predator, so the arrow pointing toward the crocodile indicates that the crocodile eats fish.
